title: CNPOS Shot Contract v1_2
description: Deterministic shot-level contract for CNPOS v1_2 cinematic pipelines.

domain.description: Fixed domain identifier for shot-level payloads.

version.description: Contract version; must match CNPOS v1_2.

shot_id.description: Deterministic shot identifier (UUID or canonical string).

scene_id.description: Identifier of the scene this shot belongs to.

episode_id.description: Identifier of the episode this shot belongs to.

index.description: Zero-based index of the shot within the scene.

type.description: Shot type (CU, MS, LS, OTS, etc.).

movement.description: Camera movement (static, pan, tilt, dolly, crane, etc.).

angle.description: Camera angle (high, low, eye-level, Dutch, etc.).

composition.description: Visual composition details for the shot.

framing.description: Framing description (e.g., two-shot, close-up on protagonist).

depth_of_field.description: Qualitative description of depth of field (shallow, deep, etc.).

dialogue.description: Dialogue lines associated with this shot.

actions.description: Physical or narrative actions occurring in the shot.

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the shot in seconds.

metadata.description: Auxiliary metadata for orchestration and telemetry.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp of the shot payload.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp of the shot payload.

pipeline_id.description: Identifier of the pipeline instance that produced/modified this payload.

orchestrator_id.description: Identifier of the orchestrator managing this shot.

policy_id.description: Identifier of the governance policy applied to this shot.

flags.description: List of governance flags (e.g., content warnings, constraints).
